features.title: Beauty that lasts with minimal effort
features.text: Upholstered in premium fabric, this sofa resists stains and wear, making it ideal for homes with busy lifestyles or pets.

features.title: Support where you need it most
features.text: The mid-back design offers excellent lumbar support, ensuring you stay comfortable whether you’re reading, working, or just relaxing.

features.title: Spacious armrests, effortless comfort
features.text: Designed with broad, supportive armrests that let you sit, lean, or lounge with ease—offering the perfect balance of comfort and ergonomic support, no matter how you choose to relax.

features.title: Cushioned with care
features.text: With soft foam and cosy back cushions filled with recron, our sofa offers the perfect mix of support and sink-in comfort.

features.title: High stance, low maintenance
features.text: The raised legs not only add a sleek, airy feel to your space but also make sweeping and vacuuming underneath effortless—so your home stays fresh and tidy with minimal effort.
